title: skills.sql
content:
-- Technical skills from Hongzhe Xie's current resume

CREATE TABLE technical_skills (
    category VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
    skills TEXT[] NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO technical_skills (category, skills) VALUES
('Languages', ARRAY['Python', 'Go', 'C/C++', 'TypeScript/JavaScript', 'SQL']),
('Web & Data', ARRAY['Django REST Framework', 'React', 'Vue', 'Vite', 'PostgreSQL', 'MySQL', 'DynamoDB', 'Redis']),
('AI & Agents', ARRAY['Google ADK', 'Gemini', 'Amazon Bedrock', 'Agent orchestration', 'Structured tool calling', 'LLM application security']),
('Security', ARRAY['WebAuthn/FIDO2', 'TOTP/MFA', 'JWT/OAuth', 'RBAC (Casbin)', 'CSRF/XSS/SSRF mitigation', 'Rate limiting', 'Audit logging', 'CodeQL', 'Bandit', 'Trivy', 'Gitleaks']),
('Cloud, DevOps & Testing', ARRAY['AWS ECS Fargate', 'Amplify', 'S3', 'SES', 'CloudWatch', 'GCP', 'Docker', 'Nginx', 'GitHub Actions', 'CI/CD', 'Playwright'])
;

SELECT category, array_length(skills, 1) AS skill_count, skills
FROM technical_skills
ORDER BY category;
